body.statement: The decision problem \(\textsc{Clique}\), which asks whether a finite simple graph \(G=(V,E)\) contains a set of \(s\) pairwise adjacent vertices, is NP-complete under polynomial-time many-one reductions.

source.verbatim_statement: All the problems on the following list are complete.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the Main Theorem immediately preceding Karp's list; CLIQUE is item 3.
